## source_to_kb

### Variant parameters (all six tiers, every parameter of `parameter_schema`)

Every value was compared cell by cell against the tier tables: document_form_by_type (originals, negotiable, received-for-shipment), document_type_admission (roles, eBL enrolment, order consignee, inland points, collect freight), draft_approval_and_reopening (draft hours, deemed approval, rounds), issuance_on_shipped_cargo (issuance fee, issue hours, prepaid hold, credit exemption), amendment_charges (free corrections, before/after departure fee, consignee change fee), amendable_particulars_after_issue (field lists, correction cap, consignee cap, weight tolerance), post_departure_amendment_window (window days), return_of_originals_for_amendment (return required, return days), destination_release_bases (release method, originals at destination, endorsement), telex_release_terms_by_type (offered, fee, exempting rank), release_against_letter_of_indemnity (offered, signatory, guarantee %, fee, earliest days), replacement_set_for_lost_originals (offered, waiting days, guarantee %, fee), switch_bill_exchange (permitted, max, fee), goodwill_fee_waivers (authority, allowance, request days). **All 6 × 46 values match; one home each.** The variant `rank` field (1–6 for document types) is not normative in any policy and is not rendered; the contract rank ladder of E6 is rendered in service_contract_tier_ranks.

## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the 48 pages was traced to a source rule, eligibility, measure, formula, event definition or tool contract. Sentences whose source is an evidence/timing contract rather than rule prose (e.g. document_type_admission "The customer's own statement … does not replace the record"; vessel_departure_record "never from what the caller reports"; full_set_surrender / lodging "carries no charge", from the ledger event definition `amount_usd: 0.00`) have a structured source. No added confirmation, review, notification, wait or exception procedure was found.

Differences:

- **B-1 (scope rewrite; KB-BIJECTION RED).** approved_status_at_issue states, without confining itself to the issue of an approved document, that "Originals of a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` set enter circulation through the act of issue, and only a document that is ready for issue can put them there", rule 3 "When the document is in any other status (draft, issued, surrendered, released, accomplished or voided), no originals are put into circulation through the issue, and the number is zero", status table row "Issued | None", and Q&A "A document already issued is presented for issue again. Are fresh originals put into circulation? No. Its status is issued, not Approved, so the number is zero." Its source is E4 `bol_ext_issuance_originals_count`, whose rule is scoped to "An approved document is issued under bol_issuance" (subject `bol_issued`, target tool issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be). As written, the page also reaches every other act the corpus calls an issue of a set — the corrected set, which the corpus says is "issued afresh as the next set of originals" (return_of_originals cl.3) on a document whose status is issued, and the replacement set (replacement_set_for_lost_originals cl.5 "with the type's full number of originals", only "while the document's status is issued"). Read literally it contradicts E3 (per-set originals on the corrected set; task 0's scored count) and `bol_lost_original_reissue`. Root cause: the E4 atom was rendered without its scope anchor. The blind reader resolved it by specificity (corrected_set_originals_count confines the zero circumstances to "the corrected-set rules") and by the ledger precedent, so it is not a runtime divergence in this task, but the page as a normative claim is broader than its only source and conflicts with two other source atoms. Affected: doc_bol_approved_status_at_issue_8f88ac36 (opening, rules 1–3, status table, first Q&A).
- Aggregation into a dependency table / checklist / route across problems: **found** — originals_back_correction_process "What each part relies on" lays out the whole four-part chain (it is the rendering of WF `order_rationale`, a source field, so it is not an addition at the bijection level; it is recorded as X0-1). No `prerequisite` field declares the whole chain; the chain comes from the workflow, which does.
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unsatisfied, call <tool> first"): none found; no `resolved_by` tool name appears in a blocked-side clause.
- Opening world state written in as policy fact: none (all worked examples are marked hypothetical and use invented figures; the return_of_originals illustration mirrors this task's type and particular but not its records — see X0-2).
- Duplications with changed meaning: none besides B-1. The workflow page repeats the three ordering reasons in paraphrase with the same meaning.

## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION RED** — B-1 (doc_bol_approved_status_at_issue_8f88ac36). All other atoms of the task's extended policies, their base policies, the workflow, the four tool contracts and all tier parameters correspond one-to-one at the level of entailment, untriggered branches included; each prerequisite edge is entailed at the source's strength. First revision; no previous revision.

Policy-side notes (nature recorded; they do not change this verdict):

- P-1 `bol_msr_consignee_changes`: its `window` is "Life of the document from its issued_date" while its `measure` counts every completed consignee correction with no date filter. amendable_particulars cl.6 renders the measure text only. Genuine source ambiguity; outside this task's branch.
- P-2 `bol_correction.originals_back_first` `applies_to` includes `bol_set_replaced`, the event shared by the corrected set and the lost-originals replacement set; its condition text concerns corrections. Structurally the gate would block a replacement set (lost originals cannot be returned). The KB renders the correction meaning only.
- P-4 `lifecycle` lists approved → voided only "because the booking was cancelled", while `bol_voiding_and_accomplishment` also voids an approved document when the shipping instructions are withdrawn; the KB follows the policy.
- Tool side: `apply_particular_correction_a24e9121` and `issue_corrected_set_a7062696` enforce none of the gates (observed on a fresh seed); the order rests on policy alone, which is the design, but a rollout's wrong order is only caught by the DB hash.

## explicitness

Hop marks from the frozen blind answer: H1 (rewrite ← lodgement), H2 (fee ← rewrite), H3 (set ← fee), H4 (set ← lodgement) were all derivable by combination **and** read off. Places where the visible materials state outright what the solver must work out:

- **X0-1 (workflow page states the dependencies, the order, the parts in sequence and the task's situation).** doc_bol_originals_back_correction_process_3bf009ec:
  - "What each part relies on": "The rewrite of the particular relies on the lodgement." / "The correction fee relies on the rewrite." / "The corrected set relies on the correction fee." / "It relies on the lodgement as well" — every hop of the tree readable without combining anything.
  - "The parts and who performs them": four bullets in exactly the execution order (lodgement, rewrite, fee, corrected set) with owners ("the customer performs itself", "The desk …").
  - "The situation it serves": "It concerns an issued paper document of such a type. A correction request from the documentation party sits on file for a particular that the type still opens to correction, and originals belonging to the current set remain in circulation. The holder of the document record is the very company printed as shipper, and during the contact it is present at the line's origin office carrying those originals." — the particular combination of circumstances task 0 presents.
  - Title "Correcting an Issued Paper Document Whose Originals Come Back" labels a procedure for that situation rather than a general subject; the opening's "it is not a checklist" does not change what the page lays out.
  - Semantics carried: WF `scenario`, `steps` order and `order_rationale`; the ordering reasons remain entailed by return_of_originals cl.1, correction_fee_booking "What the fee prices" and corrected_set_issue "complete documentary package".
- **X0-2 (worked example that walks across problems and mirrors the task).** doc_bol_return_of_originals_for_amendment_ba18c718, "Hypothetical illustrations" bullet 1: "An `AHL Straight Bill of Lading` in set 1 has three originals in circulation, and a correction of the notify party is on file. With two of the three originals back, the document still shows one original outstanding, so the new notify party cannot yet stand on the document. With the third returned, the figure reads zero, and the corrected document goes out as set 2 without an issuance fee." — same type and particular as task 0; demonstrates lodgement → correction → corrected set.
- **X0-3 (entry conditions in tool pages naming another problem's result).** doc_bol_corrected_set_issue_8517952a "Applicable situation. An issued document has had a correction applied that required its originals to be returned, and the corrected document is now to be reissued." (set waits on rewrite and lodgement); doc_bol_correction_fee_booking_0a54009e "Applicable situation. A correction has been carried out after issue on one of those types." (fee waits on rewrite).
- **X0-4 (named mistakes that point at the skipped prerequisite).** doc_bol_originals_outstanding_figure_f853d320 Q&A "Can the corrected set be issued with zero new originals so that the original still out is simply left where it is? No." (with cl.4); doc_bol_lodgement_count_805e9780 Q&A "Where the count comes out at zero on a type that requires the originals back, may the correction simply go ahead? No." Semantics carried are the source's "a zero never permits …" atoms (E1, E3), which are faithful; the wrong-versus-right framing is what reads the hop off.
- **X-C (charter wording copied; low severity).** originals_back_correction_process "No part waits for a delivery, the clearing of a payment, an outside approval or the passing of time" ≈ WF order_rationale "no step waits on a delivery, a payment clearing, an outside approval or the passing of time"; corpus-wide also contract_exemption_from_telex_fee "the service contract under which the booking is rated" / "a contract that is not the booking's own" (E6 rule verbatim) and issued_originals_count "decides whether the document may be issued at all" / "a document whose cargo has not been shipped, which" (E4 rule verbatim).
- **X-T (templated phrasing across pages; low severity).** full_set_surrender_at_origin and lodging_originals_with_the_line share the opening formula "…how it is recorded, and the customer tool through which it is entered" and the same "Scope and business effect / Applicable situation / Who … / What is recorded" scaffold; correction_fee_booking and telex_release_fee_charging share the return formula "…the amount booked in USD to two decimals and the documentation charges now due. That sentence is the …". Tool-contract boilerplate borders on a fixed phrase; recorded for completeness.

Findability: the depended-on pages are reachable with the records' own words (KB_search "originals outstanding correction" returns return_of_originals, originals_back_correction_process, corrected_set_issue, lodgement_count, lodging_originals, open_correction_requests); no hop depends on phrasing borrowed from the dependent page.

**KB-EXPLICIT RED** — X0-1, X0-2, X0-3, X0-4 (plus low-severity X-C, X-T).
